style: Instrumental downtempo electronic soundtrack for a space exploration strategy game, inspired by Ben Prunty's FTL and FTL Multiverse. A memorable mellow pulse-wave synthesizer melody, delicate interlocking plucked synth arpeggios, rounded resonant synth bass, slowly breathing filtered pads, small FM bell accents and stereo delay. A gentle, sparse electronic rhythm with soft ticks. Melancholic, curious and mysterious, drifting through distant stars. Spacious, understated and melodic. Purely instrumental. Dm, 108 BPM.
